mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates signal accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates labor market deterioration, triggering economic slowdown expectations that cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: Joint low federal funds rates (<0.1%) and high unemployment rates (>5.5%) signal active monetary policy response to labor weakness, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and UNRATE > 5.5% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts above 1500 thousand units signal sustained consumer demand momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1500 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 100.1 (index 2017=100) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.1.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 270 indicates elevated inflation pressures, prompting monetary tightening expectations that cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 270.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 600,000 million dollars signal robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 600000.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market recovery regimes, nonfarm payrolls above 145,000 thousand indicate accelerating job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 145000 during labor market recovery.
